text:
Reward operations — hi-fi mockups (rev 1)
One page, four zones: Now · Payments · Past cycles · Accounting. Vocabulary: Cycle / Distribution / Calculate / Collect / Distribute / payments. Who did a step and when live only in the ⓘ tooltips and exports. Exceptions are never green.

Amount rule (whole interface): below 100,000 sats → "64,350 sats"; otherwise 3 significant figures with the unit word always present. Unit by context: sBTC for anything held or moved on Stacks (accrued, calculated, collected, direct payouts, fees); BTC for payouts that went out over Bitcoin (sent / arrived). Sorting, filtering and totals always use the underlying integer sats, never the rendered string.

Projection (distribution-first): the first tile is the earnings number — before calculation it is the projection with earned-so-far beneath; after, it is the exact calculated amount with projected → got. One cycle line below the tiles carries the whole-cycle figure. Details & accuracy are collapsed under the Now card.
Canvas note: Matter / Matter Mono cannot load here, so headings and figures render in the fallback stack. The repo pages (design/mockups/index.html) use the real fonts.
Quiet state (most days): the Now card accrues for the NEXT distribution, names the last completed cycle on one line, and nothing is actionable. Past cycles shows the just-finished cycle first.
